devices.name: HALL TABLE
devices.look: A hall table by the door. Mail, keys that open nothing, and a notice someone slid under the door.

say: REGISTRY HOUSING NOTICE. RESIDENT 4C NOT VERIFIED FOR 72 HOURS. FLAT SCHEDULED FOR REALLOCATION. NO ACTION REQUIRED.
a takeaway menu, a final reminder, and a postcard of a fish, blank, addressed to Moth, in Moth's handwriting.

devices.name: CORKBOARD
devices.look: A corkboard over a fishing rod that has never been out of its wrapper.

say: you and Moth at the noodle stall. on the back, in marker: "proof we eat. —M"
"BEFORE LEAVING: 1. feed Sprat. 2. water Fern. 3. tape the camera. 4. tape the other camera. 5. trust nobody (except you, reading this. hi)." items 1 and 2 are not ticked.
a fishing rod, still in its wrapper. the receipt is pinned above it. on the receipt: "for my status. —M"

devices.name: RECORD PLAYER
devices.look: A record player on a crate. One record on it, looping. Moth liked routines.

say: the song, every 2 s. a single, cut short. it skips back to the start before it ends.
a hand-labelled single. on the label: "OURS." no title. Moth's writing: "you were there. you know it."

devices.name: MOTH'S RIG
devices.look: Three screens, one keyboard, a lot of tape. The webcam is taped. So is the spare.

say: MOTH-PC · LOCAL LOGIN DISABLED BY OWNER. REMOTE ACCESS: FRIENDNET CONTACTS ONLY.
"no, you can't log in here. nobody can. friends come in through FRIENDNET, like friends. —M"

devices.name: SPRAT'S TANK
devices.look: A fish tank with a heat lamp in the lid. One fish. He's fine.

say: Sprat swims a slow lap of victory. he's fine.
Sprat looks at you, then at the feeder, then at you. he's fine. he would like it noted that he's fine.
LAMP: 26°C. the lid is warm. something has been sleeping on it.

devices.name: SMART POT
devices.look: A smart pot by the window. The plant in it is called Fern. It is not a fern.

say: MOISTURE 3%. WATERING SCHEDULE SUSPENDED: OWNER NOT VERIFIED.
POT: moisture within tolerance. further water declined.

devices.name: ANSWERING MACHINE
devices.look: A landline with an answering machine. Moth said apps listen. Tapes only listen when asked.

nodes.name: FRIENDNET
nodes.look: A chat service. Everyone's status line is written by its owner, and it shows.
nodes.status: 4 contacts online · 1 of them is a process

say: moth · status: "gone fishing (not fishing)" · last seen 3 days ago · profile photo: a moth, wearing sunglasses, indoors.
you · status: "pretending to be busy" · account flagged: identity pending. your status was set by you, in a better week.
NO LOGS KEPT · status: "serving noodles to the dead. the dead tip better."
moth's wall: "happy hatch day, moth!! 0412 forever" · the fixer: "your tab has chapters now." · REGISTRY-WD: "just checking."

nodes.name: MOTH-PC
nodes.look: Moth's computer, from the inside. It smells of solder and fish food.

say: "if you're not my friend, go away. if you are, you know where the key is."
[logic module] SWITCH. passes a signal while it is on, stops it while it is off. Moth's label: "a door for signals."

goals.text: Moth's PC only takes friends: get on FRIENDNET
open Moth's drawer on MOTH-PC (your key chip)
unseal the journal: play it Moth's song

texts.goals.done: done. washer 3, the market laundromat. the market gate is at Downtown's west end.
door.out: you pull the door shut behind you. the lock clicks. it knows the key.
net.down: no line out: your deck can't reach past this room. it needs uplink.so.
tape.1: MESSAGE 1 OF 1. [beep] "hey. it's me. if this isn't you: hello Registry, the plants are plastic, go home. (they're not. sorry, Fern.) if it is you: you got the key, so the fixer didn't eat it. good." [press play to continue]
tape.2: "don't touch the rig, it won't let you, I made sure. come in the front door like a friend: FRIENDNET. the drawer takes the key. the journal takes the song. you know the song. you sang it wrong for a year." [press play to continue]
tape.3: "one more thing. a dog comes by. a Registry dog, every few seconds. it's not personal, it's a policy. do your thing while it's out. feed Sprat. bye." [click] END OF MESSAGES.
notes.read: "notes to self. 1) the record loops every 2 s, the song takes longer than that. one song at a time or it talks over itself. 2) SWITCH: a door for signals. open it when the dog leaves. shut it behind the first song. 3) timers: one beat is 1 s. 4) water Fern."
photos.read: photos/: "SPRAT, day 1. (he's a fish. he's fine.)" · "karaoke, the usual booth. our song: HIGH, LOW, MIDDLE. yes, the title is the tune. you sang it wrong." · "you, asleep at the noodle stall. the fixer charged you rent."
journal.read: journal, last entry: "found something in the Registry I wasn't meant to. a list. you're on it. so am I, now. going where the Registry doesn't look: the water. your pass is in my jacket. the jacket's in washer 3 at the market laundromat. nobody searches a wash cycle. follow the trains. —M"
